visualCharacteristics.purpose: look-alike items each with a heading (name or episode), role, description, optional link and an embedded video

contentPattern.structure: one row per item: cell 1 body with heading, optional bold role paragraph, description and optional link (e.g. Contact Kyla); cell 2 video link (YouTube or Vimeo URL, or .mp4), optionally with a poster image. With a poster the video loads on click; without, it loads lazily when scrolled into view

usage: Webinar episode listings and Faces of MNP video profiles on industry pages
reuseGuidance: Use for repeating text-plus-video items. For a single standalone video or third-party embed use embed-interactive.
